Preserve geometry, colors, all unmentioned details and matte brushwork. Make only five changes: (1) One paper-bird wing folds across and over the mirror's near brass rim while the rest of the bird remains reflected inside; paper geometry continuous. (2) The moth's lower left wing tucks behind the mirror frame instead of resting entirely in front, preserving one moth. (3) The watering can's spout touches the mirror surface and its reflected tip appears just inside the mirror at the same angle, without moving the can. (4) The silver key's toothed end slips under one raised fold of the teal cushion instead of lying fully on top, with plausible occlusion. (5) The framed gold crescent's lower tip passes in front of its little gold star instead of behind it, clean layered ornament. No extra elements, disconnected edges, global repaint, text or watermark.
